As per the prosecution story, on 10.03.2024, 42 years prosecutrix submitted an application in writing alleging that on 10.03.2024, at around 10:00 A.M., she was raped by appellant/accused.
On the basis of complaint, FIR was registered.
After investigation, charge-sheet has been filed.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the appellant has submitted that appellant has not committed any offence.
He is innocent.
He has been falsely implicated due to enmity with one Prahlad Soni in whose field the complainant works as laborer and on the basis of instigation by Prahlad Soni a false FIR has been lodged.
Appellant has no criminal background.
Therefore, it is prayed that appellant may be released on bail.

5. On the other hand, learned counsel for the State as well as learned counsel for the objector have opposed the prayer for grant of bail to the appellant, but learned counsel for the State has fairly admitted that in DNA report, no "Y" chromosome was found on the vaginal slide of the prosecutrix.
DNA report has been received and it does not confirm the story of rape.

6. Having taken into consideration all the facts and circumstances of the case and the fact that final conclusion of trial of the case will take considerable time, but without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, I am of the view that it is a case in which further pre-trial detention of the appellant is not warranted.

Consequently, this appeal under Section 14-A of the Scheduled Castes and the Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989 stands allowed and impugned order dated 21.08.2024 passed by learned Special Judge, SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, District Katni NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-JBP:46124 3 CRA-10018-2024 (MP) is set-aside.
7.

sentences.text: It is directed that appellant - Gudua @ Hemraj @ Guddu Thakur be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.

He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 480(3) of BNSS, 2023/439 of Cr.P.C.
8.
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
